The '''Imperial Special Ops Center''' was a military base established by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] along the [[Main Production Boulevard]] in the [[Upper Industrial Sector]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR" /> Around [[3643 BBY]], [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Kolvin]] was assigned by the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] as mission leader of the base which was positioned near an ancient [[Darth Revan's complex|complex]] associated with [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]] to unlock its secrets.<ref name="Ghosts of Nar Shaddaa">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Ghosts of Nar Shaddaa|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Special Ops Center appears as part of the Upper Industrial Sector on Nar Shaddaa in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TOR" />
